focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期报告义务收紧，中国出口企业需强化数据合规
focus.summary: 2026年9月，欧盟委员会发布CBAM过渡期第三份实施指南，明确要求进口商在季度报告中提供更细颗粒度的嵌入碳排放数据，并加强对中国等第三国生产设施的核查。未如实申报可能面临每吨碳排放50至100欧元的罚款。中国钢铁、铝、化肥等行业出口商应尽快建立产品碳足迹核算体系，与欧盟进口商协同完成数据申报，并评估在欧盟设立合规主体的必要性。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会税收与海关同盟总司 · 2026.09.16
focus.title_en: EU Tightens CBAM Transitional Reporting Obligations, Chinese Exporters Urged to Strengthen Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: In September 2026, the European Commission issued its third implementation guidance for the CBAM transitional period, requiring importers to provide more granular embedded emissions data in quarterly reports and intensifying verification of production facilities in third countries including China. Failure to report accurately may trigger penalties of EUR 50 to 100 per tonne of emissions. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium and fertiliser sectors should establish product carbon footprint accounting systems, coordinate with EU importers on data submission, and assess the need to set up a compliant entity within the EU.

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭承认与执行中国法院商事判决，明确互惠关系认定标准
case.summary: 2026年8月，新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）在一起中资企业申请承认与执行中国法院民商事判决案中，认定中新之间已形成事实互惠关系，裁定承认该判决并允许在新加坡执行。法院重点审查了中国法院管辖权、程序正当性及公共政策例外。该案为中国企业在新加坡及普通法辖区执行中国判决提供了重要先例，建议在跨境合同中优先选择新加坡法院管辖或约定仲裁，以增强裁决可执行性。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭 · 2026.08
case.title_en: Singapore International Commercial Court Recognises and Enforces Chinese Commercial Judgment, Clarifying Reciprocity Test
case.summary_en: In August 2026, the Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) recognised and enforced a Chinese civil and commercial judgment in a case brought by a Chinese company, finding that de facto reciprocity exists between China and Singapore. The court examined the Chinese court's jurisdiction, due process and public policy exceptions. This decision offers a significant precedent for Chinese enterprises seeking to enforce Chinese judgments in Singapore and common law jurisdictions. Parties are advised to choose Singapore court jurisdiction or arbitration in cross-border contracts to enhance enforceability.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Commercial Court · August 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境商事纠纷一站式解决平台，整合调解仲裁诉讼服务
policy.summary: 2026年9月，粤港澳大湾区跨境商事纠纷一站式解决平台正式上线，整合粤港澳三地调解、仲裁与诉讼资源，为企业提供在线立案、跨境送达、法律查明及多元解纷服务。平台依托前海、南沙、横琴等合作区，引入港澳调解机构和仲裁机构入驻。内地企业可借此降低跨境维权成本，建议在合同中约定适用大湾区调解规则或选择港澳仲裁机构，以提升争议解决效率。
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Launches One-Stop Cross-Border Commercial Dispute Resolution Platform Integrating Mediation, Arbitration and Litigation
policy.summary_en: In September 2026, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area officially launched a one-stop cross-border commercial dispute resolution platform, integrating mediation, arbitration and litigation resources across the three jurisdictions. It offers online case filing, cross-border service of process, legal ascertainment and diversified dispute resolution services. Supported by the Qianhai, Nansha and Hengqin cooperation zones, the platform hosts Hong Kong and Macao mediation and arbitration institutions. Mainland enterprises can reduce cross-border enforcement costs; parties are advised to stipulate GBA mediation rules or choose Hong Kong/Macao arbitration institutions in contracts to improve dispute resolution efficiency.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Department of Justice · September 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规收紧，中企赴美技术合作需重构合规路径
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部2026年9月发布的对外投资审查最终规则，将半导体、人工智能、量子计算等领域对华投资限制扩展至合资、许可及研发合作。中国出海企业应重新评估在美技术合作架构，剥离敏感技术接触点，建立投资前筛查机制，并利用豁免条款（如公开市场证券投资）降低合规风险。建议在交易文件中加入监管变化条款，明确因审查导致的退出或调整机制，同时保留向财政部申请豁免或咨询的通道。
analysis.source: 来源：美国财政部投资安全办公室 · 2026.09
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: New US Outbound Investment Rules Tighten, Chinese Firms Must Rethink Compliance Paths for US Tech Cooperation
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury's final outbound investment screening rules issued in September 2026 extend restrictions on China-bound investment in semiconductors, AI and quantum computing to joint ventures, licensing and R&D cooperation. Chinese outbound enterprises should reassess their US technology cooperation structures, divest sensitive touchpoints, establish pre-investment screening mechanisms, and leverage exemptions (e.g., publicly traded securities) to mitigate compliance risks. It is advisable to include regulatory change clauses in transaction documents, specify exit or adjustment mechanisms triggered by screening, and preserve channels to seek Treasury exemptions or guidance.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Department of the Treasury, Office of Investment Security · September 2026
